svg.aria-label: Julian Labs WebSocket architecture: Akamai to Zuplo to Akamai to Linode, with two-way Firewall for AI HTTPS inspection.

g.text: Julian Labs / Akamai → Zuplo → Akamai → Linode
Deny → notify client; drop this message
The connection stays open after a deny.
Origin ping: every 30 s · max message: 1 MiB
Echo bytes + message type preserved at origin
Public WSS; Nginx → Node over loopback WS
Toxic input: deny; next normal message passed
Two logical passes through one property
Return traffic follows the same chain in reverse
Snapshot of the working echo demo. Full endpoint URLs, alternate origin DNS, configuration notes and test evidence are in README.md.
